title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?
abstract: arXiv:2604.10547v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Agent^2 RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training, which tests whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute post-training pipelines that improve foundation models. RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. Agent^2 RL-Bench provides a unified agent-facing interface: each run starts from an isolated workspace containing a base model, task data, instructions, and a grading API, and agents must iterate within a fixed budget by training models and submitting artifacts for evaluation. translated_title: Agent² RL-Bench：大语言模型智能体能否工程化构建智能体强化学习后训练？
translated_abstract: 我们推出了 Agent² RL-Bench，这是一个用于评估智能体强化学习后训练的紧凑型诊断基准，它测试大语言模型智能体能否自主地设计、实现、调试并执行能够提升基础模型性能的后训练流水线。强化学习后训练日益成为驱动模型对齐与专门化的关键手段，然而现有基准大多是静态的，只奖励监督微调或脚本生成，而未能评估智能体闭环完成交互式强化学习流程的能力。Agent² RL-Bench 提供了一个面向智能体的统一接口：每次运行从一个隔离的工作区开始，其中包含基础模型、任务数据、指令说明和一个评分 API，智能体必须在固定预算内通过训练模型并提交产物进行评估来不断迭代。该基准涵盖三个层级的六项任务，从静态的基于规则的训练，到基于评判模型的优化，再到带轨迹采集的闭环在线强化学习。两项诊断技能……
tldr: 该论文提出了 Agent² RL-Bench——一个紧凑的诊断基准，通过面向智能体的统一接口和三个层级的六项任务，评估大语言模型智能体能否在固定预算内自主设计、实现、调试并闭环执行强化学习后训练流水线来提升基础模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agent² RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark with a unified agent-facing interface and six tasks across three levels, evaluating whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute closed-loop RL post-training pipelines to improve foundation models within a fixed budget.
